_comment: Placeholder script. Replace text with your own lines. 'shot' is a framing preset (dude, dude_tight, bot, bot_tight, wide). 'react' adds reactions in seconds relative to the line start (negative = before). 'voice' is an optional path to your recorded or synthesized take; without it build_timeline.py makes a placeholder babble so the scene, mouth and cuts can be checked before any TTS.
